subject.title: fix(agents): retry same profile before timeout auth rotation

question: Should ordinary assistant-stage timeouts receive one same-profile retry before OpenClaw rotates an auth profile or advances the configured fallback chain?
rationale: This is an intentional change to existing timeout, auth-profile, and fallback semantics rather than a mechanical defect repair; the repository policy treats provider routing and fallback changes as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Adopt bounded retry
options.body: Accept one same-profile ordinary-timeout retry, contingent on exact-head runtime proof and session-transcript validation before merge.

options.title: Keep immediate failover
options.body: Reject the new retry policy and retain the current behavior of moving directly to profile rotation or fallback after the initial ordinary timeout.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded retry
recommendation.body: Accept one same-profile ordinary-timeout retry, contingent on exact-head runtime proof and session-transcript validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged idle-timeout escalation work is the closest established owner signal for the assistant timeout failover policy.
